heightPolicy: No measured DEM bundled in this detail pack; existing base shape and relief are not promoted into detail.

provenance.citation: USGS Astrogeology / NASA Voyager and Galileo SSI Europa Voyager-Galileo SSI Global Mosaic 500m
provenance.license: USGS/NASA public-domain planetary imagery; retain product and mission attribution.
provenance.processing: Pinned full GeoTIFF; decode 8-bit single-band raster; map source positive-west 0..360 with 180W prime center to east-positive -180..180 using reversal plus half-raster seam shift; Lanczos resize to 512/1024/2048; JPEG quality 88.
provenance.proceduralHeight: Deterministic sinusoidal synthetic field, 0.5 m encoding, -96..95.5 m range; not measured relief and not derived from image pixels.

processing: Pixel-centered canonical east-positive imagery sampled bilinearly at native resolution (maximum 64 ppd); 512-pixel bounded JPEG tiles; 70-degree stereographic polar replacement, square equatorial ground spacing; little-endian uint16 scientific heights in lossless gzip. Polar imagery remains limited by native polar observations/fill.
